title: Zesty Crispy Ethiopian Chicken Doro Wot
description: A cultured and crispy Ethiopian dish featuring mature cheddar and high protein chicken, served on a hot stone plate. This midnight craving dish is a variation of the traditional Doro Wot.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, berbere spice, and salt.
Add the shredded cheese to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Dip each chicken breast into the beaten eggs and then coat in the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium high heat and cook the chicken until browned on both sides.
Transfer the chicken to a baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, heat a small skillet over medium heat and add the minced garlic and grated ginger, cooking until fragrant.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until translucent.
To serve, place the cooked chicken on a hot stone plate and spoon the garlic and onion mixture over the top.
